subject: Sponsor intro — proposed one-hour exec demo timebox
messages:
From: Anika Shah <anika.shah@helixsystems.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: David Lopez <d.lopez@helixsystems.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sponsor intro — proposed one-hour exec demo timebox

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the conversation last week — Helix is very interested in seeing a tight, exec-focused demo that showcases the latency/cost story for inference at scale. Our CIO (Neel) and CTO (Carmen) are both available the week of Mar 22–26 but travel constraints mean Neel prefers afternoon PT or early-evening calls.

Could we run a one-hour, compressed demo (45 min tech walkthrough + 15 min exec Q&A)? Helpful if you can send a short agenda and 2–3 proposed time slots that work for Redwood exec/SE leadership.

Also: we may have a small procurement observer on the call — I can loop them in once we lock time.

Thanks,
Anika Shah
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Helix Systems

Attachment: helix-travel-availability.xlsx (spreadsheet with Neel/Carmen travel windows)
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Anika Shah <anika.shah@helixsystems.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sponsor intro — proposed one-hour exec demo timebox

Hi Anika — great to hear and thanks for the availability note. Looping Kim (CS lead) and Marcus (Solutions SE) so we can cover the exec and the deep dive.

We can do the 45/15 structure you suggest. Draft agenda attached (redwood-exec-agenda-v1.pdf). Proposed slots (all PT):
 - Tue Mar 23, 13:00–14:00
 - Tue Mar 23, 16:30–17:30 (Neel-friendly)
 - Wed Mar 24, 12:00–13:00

If Neel prefers afternoon, we should prioritize the Tue 16:30–17:30 slot. For the exec Q&A we recommend Marcus + Kim + one engineering lead (I'll join as account exec). If procurement observes, we can include a 5-minute commercial overview at the end.

Two quick asks:
 - Can you confirm final attendee list (names + titles) so we can tailor the slides?
 - If Neel is traveling, do you want a 20-minute prebrief (30-minute room) for the execs only, ~20 minutes prior to the demo?

Thanks — I'll hold the Tue/ Wed slots tentatively until we lock.

— Logan Wright
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Calendar: https://cal.redwood.com/logan
Attachment: redwood-exec-agenda-v1.pdf

Perfect — locking Tue Mar 23, 16:30–17:30 PT for Helix (Neel + Carmen). I’ll send the calendar invite with the agenda and Zoom link; please add any pre-reads.

A couple of coordination notes:
 - Can we do a 20-minute prebrief with Neel/Carmen at 16:10 PT (execs-only) to cover top-line outcomes and clarify any procurement topics?
 - Marcus, please prepare a 10-minute latency/cost slide set and a short run-of-show note so we can keep the demo to 45 minutes.
 - Logan, add a 1-slide highlevel pricing snapshot for procurement at the end — no detailed numbers, just unit economics and SLA options.
